device_enrollments.description: A screen's request to be paired: the hash of the credential the player generated, the HMAC of the short code it shows and its report. Platform-scoped until a member claims the code.
device_enrollments.lifecycle: Created PENDING with a ten-minute validity; becomes CLAIMED when a member pairs the code, which creates the device. Expiry is read lazily. Unclaimed rows are deleted one day after expiry and claimed rows 30 days after the claim (provisional until PH-13).

id.description: Backend-generated enrollment UUID the player polls.

credential_hash.description: SHA-256 of the 256-bit credential the player generated; the credential itself never reaches the server before it is used.

code_hmac.description: HMAC-SHA-256 of the normalized eight-character code under the device code key ring; the code itself is never stored.

code_key_id.description: Identifier of the code key ring entry that computed code_hmac.

report.description: The player's report of its application, model, display and supported rotations, as sent at enrollment.

status.description: PENDING until a member claims the code, then CLAIMED.

expires_at.description: Instant after which the code can no longer be claimed.

last_polled_at.description: Latest accepted status poll, which bounds polling to once per interval.
last_polled_at.nullMeaning: The player has not polled yet.

claimed_at.description: PostgreSQL-clock instant a member claimed the code.

objects.device_enrollments_credential_key: One credential hash binds at most one enrollment.
objects.device_enrollments_code_key: Live codes never collide; a colliding new code is regenerated.
objects.device_enrollments_status_expiry_idx: Counts live pending enrollments and finds expired ones to purge.
objects.device_enrollments_credential_hash_lengt: The stored credential hash is a SHA-256 digest.
objects.device_enrollments_code_hmac_length: The stored code HMAC is a SHA-256 digest.
objects.device_enrollments_report_object: The report is a JSON object.
objects.device_enrollments_expiry_after_creation: An enrollment expires after it started.
objects.device_enrollments_claim_state: A claim instant exists exactly for claimed enrollments.

devices.description: A paired screen: its identity in one company and branch, configuration, credential hash and unlink/erasure state.
devices.lifecycle: Created ACTIVE when a member claims an enrollment. Renamed, rotated and moved within the company with optimistic versions. Unlinking makes it REVOKED with erasure PENDING, irreversibly; the screen confirms erasure (CONFIRMED, credential hash deleted) or a member records a controlled reset (RESET_RECORDED). Rows are kept with the company; no runtime deletion.

company_id.description: Company that owns the device; immutable (tenant key).

branch_id.description: Branch the screen is assigned to within its company.

enrollment_id.description: Enrollment the device was claimed from; a plain identifier because enrollments are purged.

name.description: Trimmed screen name shown to members.

rotation.description: Configured clockwise rotation in degrees: 0 and 180 horizontal, 90 and 270 vertical; one the screen reported as supported.

time_zone.description: Explicit IANA time zone of the screen's local business time, set with devices.manage.
time_zone.nullMeaning: The screen follows its branch's time zone.

status.description: ACTIVE screens use every device operation; REVOKED screens can only learn they must clear and confirm it.

erasure.description: NONE while active; PENDING after unlink; CONFIRMED by the screen or RESET_RECORDED by a member.

credential_hash.description: SHA-256 of the screen's current credential.
credential_hash.nullMeaning: Erasure was confirmed, so the credential no longer authenticates.

next_credential_hash.description: SHA-256 of a rotated credential that replaces the current one on first use.

report.description: The screen's latest report of its application, model, display and supported rotations; a device statement, not a qualified profile.

last_seen_at.description: Latest authenticated device request, written at most once per minute.
last_seen_at.nullMeaning: The screen has not called since pairing.

paired_at.description: PostgreSQL-clock instant the device was paired.

revoked_at.description: PostgreSQL-clock instant the device was unlinked.

erasure_recorded_at.description: Instant the erasure was confirmed by the screen or the reset was recorded.

version.description: Optimistic concurrency token incremented once per successful change.

updated_at.description: PostgreSQL-clock instant of the latest change.

objects.devices_company_id_fkey: A device belongs to an existing company.
objects.devices_company_id_branch_id_fkey: The device's branch belongs to the same company.
objects.devices_company_id_paired_by_membership_: The pairing membership belongs to the same company.
objects.devices_company_id_id_key: Tenant key for references to devices.
objects.devices_enrollment_key: An enrollment creates at most one device and finds it when the player polls.
objects.devices_credential_key: Finds a device by credential hash; credentials never collide.
objects.devices_next_credential_key: Finds a device by its rotated credential; credentials never collide.
objects.devices_company_branch_status_idx: Lists a branch's devices and finds active devices before a branch is archived.
objects.devices_company_paired_idx: Lists a company's devices newest pairing first with stable keyset pagination.
objects.devices_name_trimmed: Names are stored trimmed and nonempty.
objects.devices_credential_hash_length: The stored credential hash is a SHA-256 digest.
objects.devices_next_credential_hash_length: The stored rotated credential hash is a SHA-256 digest.
objects.devices_next_credential_distinct: A rotation names a different credential.
objects.devices_report_object: The report is a JSON object.
objects.devices_active_state: Exactly the active devices have no erasure state.
objects.devices_active_credential: An active device always has a credential.
objects.devices_revocation_state: A revocation instant exists exactly for revoked devices.
objects.devices_rotation_pending_only_active: Only active devices can have a pending credential rotation.
objects.devices_confirmed_without_credential: A confirmed erasure leaves no credential hash.
objects.devices_erasure_recorded_state: An erasure instant exists exactly for confirmed or recorded erasures.
objects.devices_time_zone_shape: An explicit time zone looks like an IANA zone name; the API validates it against the runtime's zone database.

device_claim_failures.description: Counter rows for failed pairing-code claims, which bound guessing per person and per company.
device_claim_failures.lifecycle: Inserted on each failed claim; counted over 15 minutes and deleted one day later.

company_id.description: Company the failed claim targeted; immutable (tenant key).

objects.device_claim_failures_company_id_fkey: A failure belongs to an existing company.
objects.device_claim_failures_principal_id_fkey: A failure belongs to an existing principal.

device_audit_events.description: Append-only device lifecycle audit: pairing, renaming, rotation, moves, unlinking, erasure confirmation and recorded resets.
device_audit_events.lifecycle: Inserted in the transaction of the change it records; never updated or deleted by the runtime. Retention follows PH-13.

company_id.description: Company the event belongs to; immutable (tenant key).

actor_principal_id.nullMeaning: The device itself confirmed its erasure.

actor_membership_id.description: Membership through which the person acted.
actor_membership_id.nullMeaning: The device itself confirmed its erasure.

action.description: Event name, such as device.paired or device.unlinked.

details.description: Allowlisted details such as branch IDs and rotations; never codes, hashes or network addresses.

objects.device_audit_events_company_id_fkey: An event belongs to an existing company.
objects.device_audit_events_company_id_device_id: The device belongs to the same company.
objects.device_audit_events_actor_principal_id_f: The actor is an existing principal.
objects.device_audit_events_company_id_actor_mem: The acting membership belongs to the same company.
objects.device_audit_events_company_id_id_key: Tenant key of device audit events.
objects.device_audit_events_device_time_idx: Lists a device's events newest first.
objects.device_audit_events_actor_pair: A person and their membership are recorded together or not at all.

enums.DeviceErasure: Erasure state of a device: NONE, PENDING, CONFIRMED or RESET_RECORDED.
